name: ResizableHandle
description: A react-resizable-panels wrapper. Panels, a group, and a handle that can show a grip.
intent: Let the user decide how to divide the space.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

parts.name: ResizablePanel
parts.note: Accepts defaultSize, minSize and maxSize as percentages

parts.name: ResizableHandle
parts.note: Sits between panels. withHandle renders a visible grip.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Arrow keys — resize when the handle has focus
Enter — collapse or expand where configured
requiredAttributes: An accessible name on the handle when the panels are not otherwise identifiable
notes: The library supplies keyboard resizing. The default handle is 1px wide — well under any reasonable target size.
Use withHandle on touch surfaces so there is something to grab.
Set minSize so a panel cannot be resized into uselessness.

agentRules: Use withHandle where touch or discoverability matters.
Provide a non-resizable fallback for mobile.
Persist the user's sizes if resizing is worth offering at all.
